en: The postcard is divided into two main photo sections. The upper section shows a large building complex surrounded by pine trees and a green lawn, with cars parked near the entrance. The building has a clock tower and a mix of brick and white facades. The lower section depicts a grassy courtyard outside another building, with ivy covering part of the wall. There are people sitting on the lawn, and four women in nurse uniforms standing and talking. The postcard has Norwegian text indicating the locations: 'Hedmark Fylkes Sykehus Elverum' and 'Hedmark Fylkes Sykepleierskole.'
